_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail: Cuberite, a Minecraft Java server written in C++ with Lua plugins, for 1.8 to 1.12.2 clients. Cuberite publishes no releases or signatures, only Jenkins builds (builds.cuberite.org, what download.cuberite.org points at) with a SHA-1 file on the same server, and the last build is from 2025-08-07: the script pins linux-x86_64 #445 and linux-aarch64 #135 with the SHA-256 Octail recorded on 2026-10-23, checks the SHA-1 file as well, refuses any other build unless staff set its SHA-256 (CUBERITE_SHA256, hidden), and refuses archives with paths outside the server folder. It runs on the debian image (glibc 2.28 and libstdc++). --port gives it the panel's port at every start (it overrides settings.ini); the web admin (port 8080 inside the container, not published) starts switched off. Not tagged minecraft: its plugins are Lua, not Bukkit or mods, and the version changer would replace it with a Java server, so none of the Minecraft tools apply. say is the broadcast; no EULA (not a Mojang server).
name: Cuberite
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Cuberite is a Minecraft: Java Edition server written in C++, light on memory and CPU, with plugins in Lua. It supports clients from 1.8 to 1.12.2.

startup_commands.Default: if [ ! -x ./Cuberite ]; then echo 'The Cuberite binary is missing: reinstall the server (Settings, Reinstall).'; exit 1; fi; exec ./Cuberite --no-output-buffering --port {{SERVER_PORT}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Cuberite installation (Octail): Cuberite.tar.gz from Cuberite's Jenkins (builds.cuberite.org, the file
# download.cuberite.org points at), linux-x86_64 or linux-aarch64. Cuberite publishes no release or signature, only
# a SHA-1 file next to each build on the same server, so the script pins a build per architecture with the SHA-256
# Octail recorded on 2026-10-23 (x86_64 #445, aarch64 #135, both built 2025-08-07 from master), checks that one
# and the SHA-1 file too, and refuses any other build unless staff set its SHA-256 in CUBERITE_SHA256.
# Worlds, settings.ini, webadmin.ini, the player lists and plugins you added stay on reinstall; the bundled
# plugins (Core, ...) are replaced with the build's.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
	echo "Installation failed: $*"
	exit 1
}

case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64 | amd64)
	JOB=linux-x86_64
	PINNED_BUILD=445
	PINNED_SHA256=929293822b419c631493d7502b31f3fa04ba82deef82c79c83dea3316d1e2aae
	;;
aarch64 | arm64)
	JOB=linux-aarch64
	PINNED_BUILD=135
	PINNED_SHA256=0e390df1eb3c70fa58280d6bbd6a2dbb9bf27e151b07a622423984819d5431db
	;;
*) fail "Cuberite builds Linux servers for x86_64 and aarch64 here; this node is $(uname -m)" ;;
esac

BUILD="${CUBERITE_BUILD:-pinned}"
WANT=$(printf '%s' "${CUBERITE_SHA256:-}" | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
if [ -z "${BUILD}" ] || [ "${BUILD}" = pinned ]; then
	BUILD="${PINNED_BUILD}"
fi
case "${BUILD}" in
*[!0-9]*) fail "the Cuberite build (${BUILD}) must be a number or pinned" ;;
esac
if [ -z "${WANT}" ]; then
	[ "${BUILD}" = "${PINNED_BUILD}" ] ||
		fail "build ${BUILD} has no checked SHA-256: staff set Cuberite SHA-256 for it, or use the pinned build ${PINNED_BUILD}"
	WANT="${PINNED_SHA256}"
fi
echo "${WANT}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "Cuberite SHA-256 must be 64 hex characters"

BASE="https://builds.cuberite.org/job/${JOB}/${BUILD}/artifact"
WORK=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "${WORK}"' EXIT

echo "Downloading Cuberite ${JOB} build ${BUILD}"
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 900 --retry 3 -o "${WORK}/Cuberite.tar.gz" "${BASE}/Cuberite.tar.gz" ||
	fail "the download of Cuberite ${JOB} build ${BUILD} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum "${WORK}/Cuberite.tar.gz" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
[ "${GOT}" = "${WANT}" ] || fail "Cuberite ${JOB} build ${BUILD} doesn't match its SHA-256 (expected ${WANT}, got ${GOT})"
SHA1=$(curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 60 --retry 3 "${BASE}/Cuberite.tar.gz.sha1" | cut -d ' ' -f 1) ||
	fail "Cuberite's Jenkins has no SHA-1 file for build ${BUILD}"
[ "$(sha1sum "${WORK}/Cuberite.tar.gz" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "${SHA1}" ] ||
	fail "Cuberite ${JOB} build ${BUILD} doesn't match the SHA-1 file next to it"
LIST=$(tar -tzf "${WORK}/Cuberite.tar.gz") || fail "Cuberite.tar.gz is damaged"
grep -qx Cuberite <<<"${LIST}" || fail "Cuberite.tar.gz holds no Cuberite binary"
if grep -Eq '(^/|(^|/)\.\.(/|$))' <<<"${LIST}"; then
	fail "Cuberite.tar.gz has paths outside the server folder"
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
tar -xzf "${WORK}/Cuberite.tar.gz" -C /mnt/server
chmod 0755 Cuberite

# The web admin listens on 8080 inside the container, which the panel doesn't publish; it starts switched off.
# Set Enabled=1, a [User:name] with a Password and a port the server owns to use it.
if [ ! -f webadmin.ini ]; then
	printf '[WebAdmin]\nPorts=8080\nEnabled=0\n' >webadmin.ini
fi

echo "Cuberite ${JOB} build ${BUILD} installed (SHA-256 ${GOT} checked). Minecraft Java 1.8 to 1.12.2 clients can join."

variables.name: Cuberite Build
variables.description: The Jenkins build to install: pinned for the build Octail checked (x86_64 #445, aarch64 #135), or a build number together with its SHA-256 below. Applied on the next reinstall.

variables.name: Cuberite SHA-256
variables.description: The SHA-256 of Cuberite.tar.gz for a build other than the pinned one, as you checked it yourself (Cuberite's Jenkins lists only a SHA-1 next to the file). Empty for the pinned build.
